hooks.command: out=""; for d in $(find . -maxdepth 3 -name .git -type d 2>/dev/null); do repo=$(dirname "$d"); branch=$(git -C "$repo" branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$branch" ]; then if [ -n "$out" ]; then out="$out; "; fi; out="${out}${repo}: ${branch}"; fi; done; if [ -n "$out" ]; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"UserPromptSubmit","additionalContext":"Git branch status - %s"}}' "$out"; else printf '{}'; fi
